rule:
PHD-MAIN-BASELINES-v1 5.4 item 5 (and 8 'input check' figures): the coordinate check of the GeoGS ALS input, one figure per site
(jointbuildgs:dev, CPU; IMG=dev run_als_cpu.sh). Rules of the figures (order 8): the title is the one thing to see; one colour job (the ALS
building part in orange against LoD2 in black; the rest of the ALS TIN, not given to GeoGS, in grey as context); names on the figure, no
legend; the numbers in one line under it; the numbers in a json beside the png.

  left   plan view (local frame x = E - 690953, y = N - 5336071, m) over the extent of the ALS building part + 5 m (the LoD2 buildings
         run past the box): the ALS building part given to GeoGS (als_building.obj faces) filled, the LoD2 surfaces' outlines (faces of
         type 0 roof and 1 wall, as lod2.obj) on top, the section line dashed
  right  the vertical section along that line: LoD2, the ALS building part, the left-out ALS faces (ground and faces with one building
         vertex) in grey
Section by rule, fixed before drawing: the building with the largest footprint among those wholly inside the box (DR footprints.json,
inside_share >= 0.99), through its footprint centroid along the footprint's shorter principal axis (across the roof), from 8 m before to
8 m after the footprint. Its numbers: the roof-height difference ALS building part - LoD2 at 0.25 m steps inside the footprint where
vertical rays from above hit both (median, count).
  python als_figs.py <site>     -> /figs/geogs_als_coords_<site>.png, .json
